restrictions.issuer_operator: Only assigned issuerIds; no member directory or claims by default.
restrictions.support_readonly: Technical aggregate only; no claims, PII, members or audit.
restrictions.security_admin: Tenant-authorized security events; no membership mutations.
restrictions.tenant_admin: No global authority; issuer operations require their own domain policy.

note: USR-T01 materializes these unchanged tenant-local capabilities in console-members.openapi.json. operator:read only establishes token eligibility; local authorization and fresh MFA govern admin writes. Acceptance instead requires the same verified identity/email and a valid invitation; no directory access. Handlers remain pending USR-T03–T07.
